Release notes are written for the people who have to live with the change, so each entry says what moved, why it moved, and what a reader has to do about it before the next deploy window opens. An entry that only names the ticket leaves the reader to reconstruct the change from the diff, and most readers will not do that; they will ship and find out. Write the consequence first, keep the mechanism to one sentence, and link the migration steps instead of pasting them into the paragraph.
